metaTitle: Flippin: Flashcards & Speaking Practice for iPhone and iPad
metaDescription: Speak a new language every day. Flippin turns the phrases you'll actually say into flashcards you can hear, flip and practice: vocab games, speaking practice, streaks and 32 languages.
ogTitle: Flippin: Speak a New Language Every Day
heroEyebrow: Flashcards & speaking practice for iPhone and iPad
heroTitle: Speak a New Language Every Day
heroLead: Flippin turns the phrases you'll actually say into smart flashcards you can hear, flip and practice in a few minutes a day.
heroNote: Free to start · No account needed · iOS 18 or later
heroPhoneAlt: Flippin's Study screen with the Spanish card “Me encanta esta ciudad.”, a 12-day streak and 18 of 25 cards toward the weekly goal
createTitle: Type It Once, Hear It Right
createLead: Type a word or phrase in your language and the translation fills itself in. Tap the speaker on either side of a card to hear it spoken.
createPoints:
• Automatic translation as you type, on-device with Apple Translation when the language is installed
  • One tap on swap to type in either language
  • Notes, tags and favorites keep what you learn organized
  • Free Google and system voices with adjustable speed; Premium adds nearly 1,000 natural Speechify voices
createPhoneAlt: Add Card screen: “Can you take a photo of us?” translated into Spanish
createCutAlt: Phrase panel with the English phrase and its Spanish translation “¿Nos puedes sacar una foto?”
gamesLead: Short sessions that feel like a game: a progress bar, combos, instant feedback and a summary with your accuracy at the end.
gamesPoints:
• Flashcards: recall, show the answer, then Again or Got it Free
  • Match: six pairs against the clock Free
  • Multiple choice, fill in the blank, listen and type Premium
  • Cards you miss come back a few cards later, so they stick
gamesPhoneAlt: Multiple-choice exercise: “Vamos a la playa.” answered correctly with “Let's go to the beach.”
gamesCutAlt: Feedback banner: Nice! Vamos a la playa.
speakLead: Hold the mic, say the phrase, and Flippin checks it with speech recognition. Saying it out loud is how it becomes yours.
speakPoints:
• Say phrases out loud and get them checked, on-device when available
  • Can't talk right now? Type the answer instead
  • Hear any phrase again first, as many times as you like
speakPremiumNote: Speak, Listen and Type are Premium practice modes.
speakPhoneAlt: Speak exercise: say “Vamos a la playa.”, recognized correctly
speakCutAlt: Feedback banner: Nice! You said “Vamos a la playa.”
streakLead: A daily streak, a weekly goal and friendly reminders turn a few minutes a day into real progress.
streakPoints:
• A streak calendar with your best streak and the next milestone
  • A weekly goal of 10, 25, 50 or 100 cards, with a celebration when you reach it
  • “Review due cards” starts with what's due, then your mistakes, then new cards
  • Daily study and difficult-card reminders at the times you choose
streakPhoneAlt: Streak screen: a 12-day current streak, best streak 12 and the next milestone at 30 days
aiLead: Describe a topic, like ordering at a restaurant, and get a ready-to-study set of 10 to 20 cards for your language pair and level.
aiPoints:
• Edit any card, pick the ones you want, or regenerate
  • Every set is saved as a draft, so nothing gets lost
  • An AI learning coach with a daily insight based on your own progress
aiPremiumNote: AI collections and the AI coach are part of Premium; free users can try an example set.
aiPhoneAlt: AI-generated Food & Dining collection with cards like “Tengo hambre” and “Esto está delicioso”
aiCutAlt: AI collection header: Food & Dining, essential phrases for restaurants and food experiences
langLead: Learn any of 32 languages from any other. Each comes with 30 ready-made phrase collections in 11 topics, from basics and travel to food, shopping and emergencies.
langPoints:
• 11 collections free, one for every topic; all 30 with Premium
  • Preview every collection and pick the cards you want
  • A starter pack based on your interests, so your deck is never empty
langPhoneAlt: Preset Collections screen with Essential Phrases, Travel Essentials and more
pricingTitle: Free to Start, Premium to Go Further
pricingLead: Everything you need to build the habit is free. Premium removes the limits.
freePoints:
• Up to 40 cards in one language pair
  • Automatic translation, notes, tags and favorites
  • Google and system voices
  • 11 preset phrase collections, one per topic
  • Flashcards and Match practice, plus review of due cards and mistakes
  • Streak, weekly goal and overview stats
  • iCloud sync across your iPhone and iPad
premiumNote: 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers · or $4.99/month · or $79.99 once for lifetime access
premiumPoints:
• Unlimited cards and all 30 preset collections
  • AI collection generator and AI learning coach
  • Speak, Listen, Type, Multiple choice and Fill in the blank
  • Nearly 1,000 natural Speechify voices
  • Card images, AI emoji suggestions and Emoji Mode
  • Switch between language pairs
  • Detailed analytics: study-time charts, mastery, accuracy trends and badges
pricingFine: Prices are in US dollars for the United States and vary by country or region; the App Store shows your price before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings. Limited-time offers may appear in the app. See the Terms of Use.
faq1A: No. Flippin works without an account and your cards sync through iCloud. Sign in with Apple is optional: it syncs your profile, streak and subscription across devices. The AI features need it so your Premium status can be checked.
faq2A: Up to 40 cards in one language pair, automatic translation, Google and system voices, 11 phrase collections, Flashcards and Match practice, your streak, weekly goal and overview stats, and iCloud sync. Premium unlocks everything else.
faq3Q: Which devices does it run on?
faq3A: iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or later. With iCloud on, your cards and practice history sync between them.
faq4A: Any pair of 32 languages, and the app itself is available in 34 languages. See the full list.
faq5A: In your App Store account settings: iOS Settings › your name › Subscriptions › Flippin. You keep Premium until the end of the period you paid for.
ctaLead: Download Flippin for free, pick your languages, and your first phrases are ready to practice.
ctaNote: For iPhone and iPad · iOS 18 or later
